title: ROC-AUC · PR-AUC (Precision-Recall AUC)
prompt: Compare **ROC-AUC** vs. **PR-AUC (Precision-Recall AUC)**. Prove mathematically why a spike in False Positives barely changes the False Positive Rate $\frac{FP}{FP + TN}$ when $TN$ is massive, making ROC-AUC deceptively high on imbalanced datasets.
